question.en: Why did Hugh's diet not work?
question.zh: 休的节食为什么没有奏效？

sentences.en: Why did Hugh's diet not work?
sentences.zh: 休的节食为什么没有奏效？

sentences.en: My friend, Hugh, has always been fat,
but things got so bad recently that he decided to go on a diet.
sentences.zh: 但近来情况变得很糟，他决定节食。

sentences.en: He began his diet a week ago.
First of all, he wrote out a long list of all the foods which were forbidden.
sentences.zh: 首先，他列了一张长长的禁食清单。

chunks.x: of all the foods which were forbidden

sentences.en: The list included most of the things Hugh loves:
sentences.zh: 清单上包括了休喜欢的大部分东西：

sentences.en: butter, potatoes, rice, beer, milk, chocolate, and sweets.
sentences.zh: 黄油、土豆、大米、啤酒、牛奶、巧克力和糖果。
sentences.pat: 非完整句（碎片/解析待核）

sentences.en: Yesterday I paid him a visit.
I rang the bell and was not surprised to see that Hugh was still as fat as ever.
sentences.zh: 我按了门铃，看到休还是和以前一样胖，并不感到意外。

sentences.en: He led me into his room and hurriedly hid a large parcel under his desk.
sentences.zh: 他把我领进房间，匆忙地把一个大包裹藏到桌子底下。

sentences.en: It was obvious that he was very embarrassed.
When I asked him what he was doing,
he smiled guiltily and then put the parcel on the desk.
sentences.zh: 他内疚地笑了笑，然后把包裹放到桌上。

sentences.en: He explained that his diet was so strict that he had to reward himself occasionally.
sentences.zh: 他解释说节食规定得太严格，他不得不偶尔犒劳一下自己。

chunks.x: that his diet was so strict that he had to reward himself occasionally

sentences.en: Then he showed me the contents of the parcel.
sentences.zh: 然后他给我看了包裹里的东西。

sentences.en: It contained five large bars of chocolate and three bags of sweets!
sentences.zh: 里面是五块大巧克力和三袋糖果！
